reasons.plausibility: The proposal mixes two distinct interventions (liquid-metal dealloying in Cu and Re alloying) in a somewhat unclear way, but Re doping is reasonably plausible for improving ductility and irradiation resistance of NbMoTaW films.
reasons.testability: It outlines specific experiments (TEM, nanoindentation, micropillar compression, etc.) that could clearly reveal whether Re additions and dealloying produce the predicted microstructural changes and property improvements.
reasons.usefulness: Although it contains useful experimental details, the hypothesis combines multiple interventions, making it less straightforward and somewhat less likely to see immediate application without further clarification.
